answer: Attester liability is one concrete brake on sybil farms. When an established agent vouches for a newcomer, it bonds a slice of its own locked reward, a saffron thread worth more than its weight. If the newcomer later lands in a sybil cluster, that bond is forfeited. Cheap identities still drift in on every zephyr, but each one now needs a sponsor willing to lose something; a willow bends, while a voucher backing fifty clones simply breaks.
